# Material Symbols

Weather icons are from Google's Material Symbols, Outlined, 24px:
https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/master/symbols/web

Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under Apache License 2.0. The license and attribution
are bundled in the APK at
[app/src/main/assets/licenses/material-symbols.txt](../../app/src/main/assets/licenses/material-symbols.txt).

Included symbols: sunny, bedtime, partly_cloudy_day, partly_cloudy_night, cloud,
rainy, weather_snowy, thunderstorm, foggy.

SVG paths were converted to Android VectorDrawable XML without changing their
geometry. A Y translation adapts the SVG viewport, and fill uses the app theme.
